[{"id":"go","builtin":true,"content":"# Go: vets and tests the module with the race detector on every push and pull request, and builds the binaries of
# the module into dist/ (kept for 30 days) at the same time — needs: [] starts the build without waiting for the
# tests; the run fails if they do. The Go caches are kept between runs.
version: 1

defaults:
  image: docker.io/library/golang:1.25
  runs-on: [linux, docker]
  timeout: 30m

pipelines:
  ci:
    name: Build and test
    on:
      push:
        branches: ["**"]
        tags: ["v*"]
      pull-request:
        target-branches: ["**"]
      manual: true
    stages:
      - name: Test
        jobs:
          - name: test
            cache:
              - key: go
                key-files: [go.sum]
                paths: [.cache/go-mod, .cache/go-build]
            steps:
              - name: Vet and test
                run: |
                  export GOMODCACHE="$PWD/.cache/go-mod" GOCACHE="$PWD/.cache/go-build"
                  go vet ./...
                  go test -race ./...
      - name: Build
        jobs:
          - name: build
            needs: []
            cache:
              - key: go
                key-files: [go.sum]
                paths: [.cache/go-mod, .cache/go-build]
            steps:
              - name: Build the binaries
                run: |
                  export GOMODCACHE="$PWD/.cache/go-mod" GOCACHE="$PWD/.cache/go-build"
                  CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o dist/ ./...
            artifacts:
              - name: binaries
                paths: ["dist/**"]
                expire-in: 30d

# the scripts of package.json that exist. The npm cache is kept between runs, dist/ for 14 days.
version: 1

defaults:
  image: docker.io/library/node:22
  runs-on: [linux, docker]
  timeout: 30m

pipelines:
  ci:
    name: Build and test
    on:
      push:
        branches: ["**"]
      pull-request:
        target-branches: ["**"]
      manual: true
    stages:
      - name: Build
        jobs:
          - name: build
            cache:
              - key: npm
                key-files: [package-lock.json]
                paths: [.npm]
            steps:
              - name: Install
                run: npm ci --cache .npm --prefer-offline --no-audit
              - name: Lint
                run: npm run lint --if-present
              - name: Test
                run: npm test --if-present
              - name: Build
                run: npm run build --if-present
            artifacts:
              - name: dist
                paths: ["dist/**"]
                expire-in: 14d
","recommended":false},{"id":"maven","builtin":true,"content":"# Java with Maven: builds and tests the project with `mvn verify`; Kogge shows the Surefire test reports and
# keeps the packaged jars for 30 days. The local Maven repository is kept between runs.
version: 1

defaults:
  image: docker.io/library/maven:3-eclipse-temurin-21
  runs-on: [linux, docker]
  timeout: 45m

pipelines:
  ci:
    name: Build and test
    on:
      push:
        branches: ["**"]
        tags: ["v*"]
      pull-request:
        target-branches: ["**"]
      manual: true
    stages:
      - name: Build
        jobs:
          - name: verify
            cache:
              - key: maven
                key-files: [pom.xml]
                paths: [.m2/repository]
            steps:
              - name: Verify
                run: mvn --batch-mode --no-transfer-progress -Dmaven.repo.local=.m2/repository verify
            reports:
              junit: ["**/target/surefire-reports/*.xml"]
            artifacts:
              - name: packages
                paths: ["target/*.jar", "*/target/*.jar"]
                expire-in: 30d
","recommended":false},{"id":"gradle","builtin":true,"content":"# Java or Kotlin with Gradle: builds and tests the project with `gradle build` (the wrapper of the repository if
# there is one); Kogge shows the test reports and keeps the jars for 30 days. Gradle's caches are kept between
# runs.
version: 1

defaults:
  image: docker.io/library/gradle:8-jdk21
  runs-on: [linux, docker]
  timeout: 45m

pipelines:
  ci:
    name: Build and test
    on:
      push:
        branches: ["**"]
        tags: ["v*"]
      pull-request:
        target-branches: ["**"]
      manual: true
    stages:
      - name: Build
        jobs:
          - name: build
            cache:
              - key: gradle
                key-files: [build.gradle, build.gradle.kts, settings.gradle, settings.gradle.kts]
                paths: [.gradle-home/caches, .gradle-home/wrapper]
            steps:
              - name: Build
                run: |
                  if [ -x ./gradlew ]; then GRADLE=./gradlew; else GRADLE=gradle; fi
                  $GRADLE --no-daemon --gradle-user-home .gradle-home build
            reports:
              junit: ["**/build/test-results/test/*.xml"]
            artifacts:
              - name: jars
                paths: ["build/libs/*.jar", "*/build/libs/*.jar"]
                expire-in: 30d
","recommended":false},{"id":"python","builtin":true,"content":"# Python: installs the project and its dependencies (requirements.txt or pyproject.toml) into a virtual
# environment and runs the tests with pytest; Kogge shows the test report. pip's cache is kept between runs.
version: 1

defaults:
  image: docker.io/library/python:3.13
  runs-on: [linux, docker]
  timeout: 30m

pipelines:
  ci:
    name: Test
    on:
      push:
        branches: ["**"]
      pull-request:
        target-branches: ["**"]
      manual: true
    stages:
      - name: Test
        jobs:
          - name: pytest
            cache:
              - key: pip
                key-files: [requirements.txt, pyproject.toml]
                paths: [.cache/pip]
            steps:
              - name: Install
                run: |
                  python -m venv .venv
                  . .venv/bin/activate
                  export PIP_CACHE_DIR="$PWD/.cache/pip"
                  if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi
                  if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then pip install -e .; fi
                  pip install pytest
              - name: Test
                run: |
                  . .venv/bin/activate
                  python -m pytest --junitxml=report.xml
            reports:
              junit: [report.xml]
","recommended":false},{"id":"dotnet","builtin":true,"content":"# .NET: restores, builds and tests the solution in Release configuration, and publishes the result into dist/
# (kept for 30 days). The NuGet packages are kept between runs.
version: 1

defaults:
  image: mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0
  runs-on: [linux, docker]
  timeout: 45m

variables:
  DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: "1"
  DOTNET_NOLOGO: "1"

pipelines:
  ci:
    name: Build and test
    on:
      push:
        branches: ["**"]
        tags: ["v*"]
      pull-request:
        target-branches: ["**"]
      manual: true
    stages:
      - name: Build
        jobs:
          - name: build
            cache:
              - key: nuget
                paths: [.nuget/packages]
            steps:
              - name: Build and test
                run: |
                  export NUGET_PACKAGES="$PWD/.nuget/packages"
                  dotnet restore
                  dotnet build --no-restore --configuration Release
                  dotnet test --no-build --configuration Release
                  dotnet publish --no-build --configuration Release --output dist
            artifacts:
              - name: dist
                paths: ["dist/**"]
                expire-in: 30d
","recommended":false},{"id":"container","builtin":true,"content":"# Container image: builds the image of the Dockerfile on every pull request, and on the main branch and on tags
# also pushes it to your registry, tagged with the commit (and the tag). It runs on agents with Docker (label
# docker) in their shell. Set these variables of the repository in Helling (Settings → Variables):
#   REGISTRY_IMAGE     the image without tag, e.g. registry.example.com/team/app
#   REGISTRY_USER      the registry account
#   REGISTRY_PASSWORD  its password or token — secret, protected
version: 1

defaults:
  runs-on: [linux, docker]
  timeout: 30m

pipelines:
  image:
    name: Container image
    on:
      push:
        branches: [main]
        tags: ["v*"]
      pull-request:
        target-branches: ["**"]
      manual: true
    stages:
      - name: Build
        jobs:
          - name: build
            only:
              events: [pull-request]
            steps:
              - name: Build the image
                run: docker build --pull --tag "kogge-check:$KOGGE_COMMIT" .
              - name: Remove it
                run: docker image rm "kogge-check:$KOGGE_COMMIT"
                when: always
          - name: publish
            except:
              events: [pull-request]
            steps:
              - name: Build the image
                run: docker build --pull --tag "$REGISTRY_IMAGE:$KOGGE_COMMIT" .
              - name: Push it
                run: |
                  echo "$REGISTRY_PASSWORD" | docker login --username "$REGISTRY_USER" --password-stdin "${REGISTRY_IMAGE%%/*}"
                  docker push "$REGISTRY_IMAGE:$KOGGE_COMMIT"
                  if [ -n "$KOGGE_TAG" ]; then
                    docker tag "$REGISTRY_IMAGE:$KOGGE_COMMIT" "$REGISTRY_IMAGE:$KOGGE_TAG"
                    docker push "$REGISTRY_IMAGE:$KOGGE_TAG"
                  fi
              - name: Sign out
                run: docker logout "${REGISTRY_IMAGE%%/*}"
                when: always
